[[File:Desecrated ground.jpg|thumb|Desecrated ground]]
'''Desecrated Ground''' is a detrimental [[ground effect]] that deals [[chaos]] [[damage over time]]. The amount of damage per second inflicted by desecrated ground depends on its source. It is similar to [[caustic ground]], which both deal Chaos DOT.

==Sources==
* {{il|Desecrate}} (also these bosses use it: [[Paradisae Venenum|Alpha Paradisae]], [[The Brittle Emperor (unique monster)|The Brittle Emperor]], [[Fleshrend, Grand Inquisitor]] and [[Maligaro, The Inquisitor]], etc.)
* The {{il|Cyclone}} skill used by [[Beheader Ataguchu]] and Q'ura

==Unique items==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
 item_stats.id LIKE "%desecrated%ground%"
  OR item_stats.id LIKE "%desecrate%"
|level=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

==Related modifiers==
===Item mods===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.domain=1 AND (mod_stats.id LIKE "%desecrated%ground%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%Desecrated ground%")
|spawn_weights=1
}}

===Map and vaal side area mods===
Desecrated ground is one of the map mods that can be rolled on [[maps]] and [[vaal side area]] (known as "secret_area" in spawn weight table):
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.domain=5 AND (mods.stat_text LIKE "%desecrated ground%" OR mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%" )
|spawn_weights=1
}}

The magnitude of the chaos damage varies depending on the map tier: 
{{#cargo_query: 
|tables=mods, mod_stats, spawn_weights
|fields = CONCAT('[[', mods._pageName, '|', mods.name, ']]')=Name, spawn_weights.tag, mod_stats.max=Damage per minute
|join on = mods._pageName=mod_stats._pageName, mods._pageName=spawn_weights._pageName 
|where = mods.domain=5 
 AND mods.id LIKE "Map%DesecratedGround%" 
 AND mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%"
 AND spawn_weights.weight > 0
 AND (
     spawn_weights.tag="low_tier_map"
  OR spawn_weights.tag="mid_tier_map"
  OR spawn_weights.tag="top_tier_map"
  OR spawn_weights.tag="secret_area"
)
|group by = mods._pageName, mod_stats.id
|order by = mods._pageName, mod_stats.id
}}
====Legacy map mods====
The following map mods can only be find in legacy map item in permanent leagues:
{{Modifier table
|q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights
|q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%" AND domain = 5
|q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0
|q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID
|stat_text=1
|level=1
|generation_type =1
|spawn_weights=1
}}
The magnitude of the chaos damage varies depending on the map tier and which legacy mods: 
{{#cargo_query: 
|tables=mods, mod_stats, spawn_weights
|fields = CONCAT('[[', mods._pageName, '|', mods.name, ']]')=Name, spawn_weights.tag, mod_stats.max=Damage per minute
|join on = mods._pageName=mod_stats._pageName, mods._pageName=spawn_weights._pageName 
|where = mods.domain=5 
 AND mods.id LIKE "Map%DesecratedGround%" 
 AND mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%"
 AND (
     spawn_weights.tag="low_tier_map"
  OR spawn_weights.tag="mid_tier_map"
  OR spawn_weights.tag="top_tier_map"
  OR spawn_weights.tag="old_map"
)
|having = SUM(spawn_weights.weight) = 0
|group by = mods._pageName, mod_stats.id
|order by = mods._pageName, mod_stats.id
}}

===Delve area mods===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.domain=17 AND (mods.stat_text LIKE "%desecrated ground%" OR mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%" )
|spawn_weights=1
}}

The magnitude of the chaos damage varies depending on depth: 
{{#cargo_query: 
|tables=mods, mod_stats, spawn_weights
|fields = required_level, mod_stats.max=Damage per minute
|join on = mods._pageName=mod_stats._pageName, mods._pageName=spawn_weights._pageName 
|where = mods.domain=17
 AND mods.id LIKE "MapDesecratedGroundDelve%" 
 AND mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%"
 AND spawn_weights.weight > 0
|group by = mods._pageName, mod_stats.id
|order by = mods._pageName, mod_stats.id
}}

===Synthesis area mods===
Synthesis map mods can only appear in Synthesis-related areas
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.domain=18 AND (mods.stat_text LIKE "%desecrated ground%" OR mod_stats.id LIKE "%ground%desecration%" )
|spawn_weights=1
}}

==Version history==

{{Version history table row|2.1.0|

}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.6|
* Desecrated Ground, created by the unique Lightbane Raiment and the new skill Desecrate, now deals flat chaos damage per minute rather than a percentage of life as chaos damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.10.8c|
* Added buff icons for Consecrated and Desecrated ground effects.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.10.8|
* Added four new Unique items, three of which were designed by our Diamond supporters. There are new general mechanics that first appear on these items: Desecrated Ground is a ground effect that does chaos damage to enemies.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
